messages:
maria: Nightly e2e-perf gate failed — p95 for longseq jumped ~30% vs baseline, build #5821. @alex @dan can someone triage? Logs: https://ci.redwood/5821/artifacts/longseq/p95.log :frowning:

alex: Looking... can you paste the specific test id and the CI job link?

maria: test: e2e_longseq_v2, job: https://ci.redwood/5821, attached flamegraph and perf summary. main metric: p95_latency 230ms -> 310ms (tokens/sec down ~30%).

CI Bot: [automated] perf-gate FAILED for nightly-run at 2026-03-15T03:12Z. Regression detected: e2e_longseq_v2 p95 +35%. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/5821/artifacts

dan: quick ask — did autoscale or node config change? I'll check cluster events.

sre-oncall: I saw a burst of GC on gpubox-12 around the window. Pulled kernel logs and dmesg; no OOMs but GC pauses aligned with perf drop. tagging @alex

alex: starting a bisect across commits from last green -> HEAD. Command I'm running: ```./scripts/perf-bisect --case longseq --since=origin/nightly-green --target=HEAD``` Will report suspects in ~20m.

maria: if bisect points to model/quant changes, we can canary to dedicated. Otherwise if it's runtime, we may revert.

alex: bisect found a likely culprit: commit 9f3b2a7 (kv-cache eviction tweak) — reproduced locally, shows +28% p95 when applied. Repro command: ```bazel test //e2e:longseq --config=perf --runs=3```

dan: ack. can we short-circuit by running a canary without that patch? run against canary infra.

alex: scheduling canary rollback on canary pool now. Triggered CI canary job: https://ci.redwood/5823 (canary rerun). ETA ~12m.

CI Bot: triggered rerun for job 5823.

alex: canary results in — p95 back to baseline (~235ms). cc @sre-oncall :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: confirmed no infra anomalies during canary. Seems change-level regression in eviction heuristic.

maria: ok filing PR to revert commit 9f3b2a7 + follow-up to harden eviction heuristics. @alex can you open the revert PR and add e2e_longseq_v2 to nightly protected set?

alex: on it. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4092 — includes revert, perf repro steps, and notes to add more coverage.

dan: can we add a short-term alert: p95 > baseline * 1.2 for longseq in next 48h? want to catch regressions quicker.

maria: yes, creating alert ticket and will link PR.

CI Bot: marking job 5821 as regression:perf and adding label.

maria: thanks team. followups: revert PR, alert, and I'll draft a short postmortem if the revert lands. Will update this thread when PR merges or if we see further anomalies.
